text.description_html:
Laurey 37506, Hammered Merlot Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull

If you are looking for unique cabinet hardware, look no further. This Art Deco inspired Merlot Kitchen Cabinet Pull features a hammered design that beautifully catches the finish color to add dimension and drama to any lightweight door or drawer. The Hammered Merlot Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull has 3 inch mounting centers and is 4.5 inches long overall. The Hammered Antique Pewter Cabinet Pull comes packaged with mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Merlot Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 37506 3 Inch Merlot Pull in Antique Pewter:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Antique Pewter
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
